{"code": "from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportions_ztest

# Prepare data for z-test
counts = [filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum(),
           filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()]
total_n = [len(filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'email']),
            len(filtered_sales[filtered_sales['channel'] == 'paid_search'])]

# Perform two-sample z-test for proportions
z_stat, p_value = proportions_ztest(counts, total_n, alternative='two-sided')

print(f'Z-statistic: {z_stat:.4f}')
print(f'P-value: {p_value:.4f}')"}
